faq_heading: Homes near Alice Brown Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Alice Brown Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Langley School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Alice Brown Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Alice Brown Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Alice Brown Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 62 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,320,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Alice Brown Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Alice Brown Elementary the median was 22 days on the market, closing at 96.6% of the list price, with 8% of sales above the list price for the 62 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Alice Brown Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Simonds Elementary (0.7 km north), U-Connect (0.7 km north) and H D Stafford Middle (1.2 km north-east).

The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names Alice Brown Elementary. Under it are the prices homes sold for within 1 km of the school.
How the Alice Brown Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Alice Brown Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Alice Brown Elementary

13 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Alice Brown Elementary in a straight line (8 elementary, 2 other, 2 secondary, 1 middle; 2 independent). The closest is Simonds Elementary, 0.7 km away, and the farthest on this list is Whytecliff Agile Learning Centre-Langley, 2.8 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Brookswood Secondary (2.2 km); the nearest independent school is St Catherines School (2.6 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Belmont Elementary (1.2 km). Other elementary schools close by: Simonds Elementary (0.7 km north), Belmont Elementary (1.2 km south-east), Uplands Elementary (1.3 km east), Nicomekl Elementary (1.6 km north), Blacklock Fine Arts Elementary (1.9 km north-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Belmont Elementary, 1.2 km south-east of Alice Brown Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Alice Brown Elementary

Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Alice Brown Elementary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median house within 1 km of Alice Brown Elementary was $1,320,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
